properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Demo Keycloak user store (oauth2-proxy-users-0.json) records password verifiers as PBKDF2-SHA256 at 27,500 iterations — Keycloak's legacy default, roughly 20x below OWASP's 600,000-iteration recommendation for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (CWE-916 territory); Keycloak itself raised defaults in later versions. Grover only halves the effective work factor; the iteration count is the weakness. Local dev environment credential material; the verifiers are real password hashes committed to the repo.

Test fixtures; production config surface.
